1624: A spy stays at a fort for 3 days. Meanwhile, use 'Infiltrate' to go in yourself and find weaknesses (up to 3) — each one weakens the enemy in the assault. Find all 3 and the whole enemy is -15%. When forming the expedition you can also choose the entry side (front, flank, rear).
1625: Neutral factions like mercenaries and woodsmen are won over by sending an army. Meet their demand in troops or gold and they join, giving you troops. If you fall short, the army simply comes back.

1630: Drag units into position inside the blue zone. Archers in back or on hills, spearmen in front of cavalry. Read the general's advice at top left and press 'Begin battle' to start the clock — until then, time is frozen.
1632: The castle is ringed by a circular wall with the gate to the north. Archers shoot from the wall walk; infantry and spearmen near the wall hurl stones at the Dead below. The Dead raise ladders and batter the wall. If the gate or wall is breached, infantry, spearmen and cavalry inside move to plug the gap on their own. If the gate breaks, they pour through it. You can sally out with 'Open gate' or a charge (G). Gate and wall HP are shown at the top.
1634: An allied army that was heading nearby arrives mid-battle. Hold on and the reinforcements hit the Dead in the back or flank.
1636: Send an army to open ground and it camps. Troops and fatigue recover while it stays. High fatigue lowers combat power (60% at fatigue 100).
1638: Use the command bar below to order infantry, spearmen, archers, cavalry or the whole army separately. Pick a type with keys 5–9 and those units glow with 'Commanding' on their cards — G charge · H retreat · J·K skills go to that type only. You can also press the buttons directly. Without orders, units go after enemies they counter.
